name: Maneuvermon
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Maquinamon] from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, this Digimon may unsuspend.
set_name: EX-11: Extra Booster Dawn of Liberator
